messages:
Maya: Heads up — I opened a small cross-repo change set we should land together: API #807 (auth header tweak), SDK #402 (client accepts new header), helm-runtime #128 (chart bump + values). Need approvals & a merge order. Proposed: API -> SDK -> Helm. :eyes:
Samir: linking the PRs? can you paste them here pls
Maya: API: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/807
Maya: SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/402
Maya: Helm: https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/128
Patrick: quick q — is API change backwards compatible for older SDKs? any migration notes?
Maya: non-breaking; header "x-rdwd-client" becomes optional when missing we fallback. added migration note in API PR description.
Elena: CI for helm is failing lint in the chart; looks like a deprecated field in values.yaml. I can fix after the API + SDK merge if we want to avoid extra churn now.
Samir: I can review API now. If Maya adds one-line migration note to the changelog file I will approve. :+1:
Maya: done — added CHANGELOG.md entry and a tiny example snippet.
CI Bot: api-ci #807 — build passed (unit) · e2e pending
Samir: approved API #807 — left a comment about adding a test for header fallback (follow-up).
Maya: thanks Samir. Once API is merged I'll cut a SDK patch and ping for an SDK approval.
Patrick: once SDK is green and approved, I'll do a staged merge for helm at 11:30 PT and run a quick canary test in staging.
Elena: FYI helm lint fix PR coming after SDK merge; I'll keep it small.
Maya: quick merge plan: 1) merge API #807 2) merge SDK #402 (after CI) 3) merge Helm #128 + Elena's lint fix 4) Patrick runs canary and promotes.
Samir: sounds good. ping me when API is merged and I'll approve SDK asap.
Patrick: tagging ops on-call — @elena this is fine for scheduled 11:30 PT canary?
Elena: yep, I'll be around. :white_check_mark:
CI Bot: sdk-ci #402 — tests failed (flake) 
Maya: re-triggering CI: /retest
CI Bot: sdk-ci #402 — tests passed
Samir: approved SDK #402 — noted the follow-up test ticket.
Maya: API merged at 1961234578 by Maya
Maya: SDK merged at 1961234586 by Samir
Patrick: Helm merged and canary started at 1961234590 — running smoke checks now:
Patrick: helm upgrade --install rdwd-runtime ./charts/rdwd --namespace staging -f values.staging.yaml
Patrick: smoke checks all good, promoting to prod in 15m. :shipit:
Elena: will open a tiny PR to fix the chart lint deprecation after prod promote.
Maya: thanks everyone — great coordination. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if anything odd shows up. :pray:
